description:
Test build, not a release. For stable builds use main/bundles/stable.json.

New: optional size limits for inline images, GIFs, albums and videos (Settings → ReVanced → Inline media):
- "Limit inline media width" + slider (% of screen width)
- "Limit inline media height" + slider (% of screen height)
Both off by default. With both on, each image uses whichever limit is tighter.

Test: try each limit alone and both together on stills, a tall screenshot, an album and a v.redd.it video (controls should fit). Reopen a thread after changing a setting.
